howToPlay: Focus on hitting enemies to spawn spirits that heal yourself or your teammates. Use the Super to protect allies and knock back nearby threats. Utilize gadgets to control spirits for damage or crowd control.
gears: Equip DAMAGE and SHIELD to improve survival and impact during combat. Use SPEED or VISION to better navigate maps and maintain control over the battlefield.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy providing utility and tactical support to their team while maintaining consistent pressure from a distance.
